summary: Nora's spoken replies can be paced for the voice: an optional formatter adds pauses for the TTS voice without changing a word, and falls back to her reply as written on any doubt.
details: New [speech.tts.format] section, off by default: mode normalise strips emoji and markdown before speech; mode model also lets one cheap call add MiniMax pause markers and interjection tags.
The model's text is spoken only when every letter and digit of her reply survives unchanged; her recorded reply never changes.
[speech.tts] gains text_normalization and a static pronunciation list; emotion no longer accepts whisper, which speech-2.8 does not support.
limitations: Nobody has listened to the paced voice yet: whether it sounds better is unverified.
With mode model, a formatted reply starts about 0.9 s later at the median and up to 2 s later.
